CustomRoutine.title: CustomRoutine
CustomRoutine.description: User created custom stretching routine with stretch sequence for cloud backup and multi-device sync

userId.description: The UID of the Google authenticated user who owns this routine

name.description: Routine name (e.g. Desk Neck Relief, Runner Cool-down)

isCustom.description: Flag indicating if this is a user-created custom routine

stretches.description: Ordered stretch items in the routine

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

PublicRoutine.title: PublicRoutine
PublicRoutine.description: Publicly shared mobility routine accessible to all community members for copying and following

id.description: Unique document ID of the public routine

authorId.description: UID of the user who published the routine

description.description: Optional description of the routine and benefits

category.description: Category tag (e.g. Desk, Back, Hips, Full Body)

stretches.description: List of stretch steps included in this routine

cloneCount.description: Number of times this routine has been copied by community members

/users/{userId}/custom_routines/{routine.description: User isolated collection of custom stretching routines

/public_routines/{routineId}.description: Community feed of shared stretching routines
